name: Romanian road user charge (rovinieta)
law: Ordonanța Guvernului nr. 15/2002, art. 1 and Anexa nr. 1 (Legea nr. 141/2025 replaced the annex from 1 September 2025 with the same tariffs for these categories): the rovinieta is a time-based charge in euro, including VAT, for periods from 1 day to 12 months, by the maximum authorised mass of the vehicle or combination and its axles: C 4 euro a day, D 7 euro a day, E 9 euro a day, F 11 euro a day (C over 3.5 to 7.5 t, D over 7.5 to under 12 t, E 12 t and over with up to 3 axles, F 12 t and over with 4 or more). A day runs from 00:00 to 24:00 (art. 1 alin. (8)). Paid in lei at the BNR rate of the month before (art. 6). Rates here exclude 21% VAT. Bridge tolls (tarif de trecere: Fetești–Cernavodă, Giurgeni–Vadu Oii, Giurgiu–Ruse) aren't included.

sources.title: Portal Legislativ: OG 15/2002, consolidation of 28.07.2025, Legea nr. 141/2025 (Internet Archive copy)
ANAF: Legea nr. 141/2025 (Monitorul Oficial nr. 699/2025): 21% VAT from 1 August 2025, OG 15/2002 Anexa nr. 1 from 1 September 2025 (Internet Archive copy)

vehicles: Goods vehicles over 3.5 t maximum authorised mass (the vehicle or combination)
tolled_roads: National roads, expressways and motorways, except national roads inside municipalities (between the town entry and exit signs).
